title: Time Taken to Mark All Nodes
summary: For each start node of an undirected tree, find the time until all nodes are marked. An odd-numbered node is marked one unit after a neighbour marked at x-1; an even-numbered node is marked when a neighbour was marked at x-2.
officialConstraints: Up to n = 10^5 nodes (search summary). Lower bound and tree guarantees not confirmed.
examples: [[0,1],[0,2]] -> [2,4,3]; [[0,1]] -> [1,2]; [[2,4],[0,1],[2,3],[0,2]] -> [4,6,3,5,5] reported from the official statement by a search summary; not fetched directly.
visualizationNotes: Playback accepts at most 12 nodes. Solution uses two tree passes (down and up) and is checked against a per-start search.
